name: Generate and save study notes
description: Checks notes can be generated and saved for later.
steps: Tap Save and confirm the library entry appears
expected: Generated notes appear and are listed in My Library.

name: Add and export a planner task
description: Checks a planner task can be saved and exported.
expected: Task appears in planner and a CSV download starts.

name: Photo solver validates missing image
description: Checks photo solver prompts for an image when none is selected.
steps: Tap Scan photo and explain answer
expected: A prompt asks the student to upload a photo.

name: Save teacher meeting link
description: Checks HTTPS teacher meeting links can be saved.
expected: Meeting link appears in the meeting list.
